title: Error surfaces take a muted red; danger actions take a vivid red
context: Once error colours stopped reusing brand coral, one red had to serve both badges and rows that carry text and buttons that confirm a destructive action. A vivid red clashes with the muted teal and court palette on dense surfaces, yet a muted red is too weak on a danger button.
decision: `--destructive` is a muted coral-red, hsl(13 60% 40%) (5.63:1 against white text), for surfaces and text that carry error or loss: badges, toasts, alerts, figures, set tally and rally rows. `--danger` is a vivid red, hsl(13 85% 42%) (4.83:1 against its near-white foreground `--danger-foreground`), for danger actions only, through the Button `destructive` variant.

alternatives.option: One vivid red for every destructive surface
alternatives.reason: Clashes with the muted teal and court palette on badges and rows.

alternatives.option: One muted red for every destructive surface
alternatives.reason: Too weak on a button that confirms a destructive action.

consequences: A destructive action takes --danger; any other error or loss surface takes --destructive.
The Button destructive variant is reserved for danger actions, not for tinted surfaces.
